name: rival
description: RIVAL — Your friends. Your PRs. Your competition.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @rival/core && npm run build -w @rival/api-client && npm run build -w @rival/api && npm run build -w @rival/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rival/core && npm run typecheck -w @rival/api-client && npm run typecheck -w @rival/api && npm run typecheck -w @rival/web && npm run typecheck -w @rival/mobile
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rival/core && npm run test -w @rival/api
